name: Bandy's Pumpkin Farm
tagline: Bandy's Pumpkin Patch opens for the season September 21, 2024
description: Bandy's Pumpkin Farm is an agritourism farm in 15020 Pumpkin Patch Rd, IL, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
